title: Atlas Research Project Frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter of a research project / Forschungsprojekt (projekte/*.md). ADR-0004: atlas.project/3 is a DIFFERENT entity than atlas.project/1|2 — those are legacy Publications and are migrated to atlas.publication/1 at startup. Carries the funded-project facts (Laufzeit, funder, Foerderkennzeichen, role), structured milestones (rendered as a timeline with next/overdue indication) and project-relevant literature refs (Paper cite keys; hanging refs are warnings, never auto-repaired). Work packages live in the Markdown body as headings with GFM checklists, not in the frontmatter. /4 (ADR-0022, issue #205) adds the optional Collection link: a file with collection_id is the Atlas side of a core Collection moved to a research project, its literature is that Collection (read live through LibraryApi), so it carries no refs; kind records the entry type (always project in this folder). /5 adds the optional history (Verlauf): one entry {date, status} per status change.

status.description: Lifecycle planned → applied → active → finished, plus terminal rejected.

role.description: Own role in the project (e.g. PI, Mitarbeiter, Antragsteller).

refs.description: Project-relevant literature as Paper cite keys → join to the LocalBib library. Hanging refs are warnings, never auto-repaired.

milestones.description: Structured milestones — the UI renders a timeline with next/overdue indication.

history.description: Verlauf: every status change, oldest first, appended by Atlas on each change; an undo replaces the whole list.

status.description: The status entered on that day.

collection_id.description: ID of the core Collection this entry belongs to (ADR-0022). Its literature list is the Collection, never refs in this file. Removed — and the last membership frozen into refs once — when the Collection is deleted.

kind.description: Entry type of a Collection entry; only set together with collection_id. Atlas stores it, the core knows nothing about it.
